name: Nocturne of Nightmares: The sleep that devours
source:
A patient is brought into the hospital where you work.
His name is Licht, and despite having no apparent injuries or illnesses, he remains in a mysterious state of never waking up.

Jackson, the attending physician, proposes using a special device to cure him.
This device allows people to enter the patient’s dream and search for his soul to bring him back to reality.

Jackson and Conrad go to the separate ward where the device is located and attempt to enter Licht’s dream. However, the device malfunctions, and you, intern Ray, and childhood friend Subaru are all dragged into Licht’s dream world.

Inside Licht’s dream, you find yourself in the landscape of the orphanage where he grew up.
However, the orphanage is now a terrifying place infested with monstrous creatures.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.nightmare2]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
一名病人被带到你工作的医院。
他的名字叫利希特，尽管没有明显的受伤或疾病，但他仍然处于一种永远不会醒来的神秘状态。

主治医生杰克逊建议使用一种特殊的装置来治疗他。
这个装置可以让人们进入病人的梦境，寻找他的灵魂，将他带回现实。

杰克逊和康拉德前往该装置所在的单独病房，并试图进入利希特的梦境。然而，装置发生故障，你、实习生雷和青梅竹马昴都被拖进了利希特的梦境世界。

在利希特的梦中，你会发现自己置身于他长大的孤儿院的风景中。
然而，孤儿院现在却是一个可怕的地方，怪物出没。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.nightmare2]Google Play[/url]]
